create_scannet_dataset: create a ScanNet dataset from a directory path with optional cache and scan filter
load_scan_from_directory: load a Scan object from its directory path with cache support
get_video_clip_from_frames: get a video clip from frames given start and end times with optional frame filter and transform
filter_scans_by_uid: filter scans by a list of space-scan UIDs from a JSON file or iterable
read_sens_header: read the binary header of a .sens file to extract camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and frame metadata
